comparisonTitle: Clinical Evaluation of Menu Options for High LDL and High HbA1c
summary: This menu evaluation categorizes 100 Indonesian dishes into strict <=10% macro-variance clusters to address the patient's elevated LDL cholesterol, high HbA1c, and associated surpluses in saturated fat, calories, sodium, and added sugar, alongside fiber and protein deficits. The selections prioritize unrefined whole foods, steamed preparations, and marine omega-3s while isolating oxidized deep-frying fats, sodium-dense cured proteins, and gelatinized starches.
recommendedOption: SOP AYAM KAMPUNG / DAGING SAPI / FREE-RANGE CHICKEN / BEEF SOUP

groups.groupName: Tier 1 - Safest Choice: Clear / Water-Poached Soups & Broths
groups.comparisonSentence: Unlike deep-fried or coconut-infused dishes, these clear broths provide high hydration and minimal saturated fats, directly supporting LDL reduction without aggravating glycemic load.
groups.message: These clear, water-poached soups and broths help combat your sodium and calorie surpluses while providing lean protein to bridge your protein deficit. They avoid the lipid peroxides found in fried alternatives. Order the free-range chicken or beef soup, and request reduced salt to protect your cardiovascular health.

groups.groupName: Tier 2 - Good Choice: Boiled Vegetables & Fresh Lalapan
groups.comparisonSentence: Compared to oil-drenched stir-fries, these boiled greens deliver essential dietary fiber and potassium with zero added lipids, helping correct your fibre deficit and blood pressure.
groups.message: Boiled vegetables and raw plant foods provide vital soluble and insoluble fibers that slow carbohydrate absorption, assisting in HbA1c control while binding LDL cholesterol in the gut. They contain no added oils or sugars. Order a large portion of boiled water spinach or raw lalapan, but skip heavy peanut sauces.

groups.groupName: Tier 3 - Good Choice: Steamed Whole Plant Proteins & Pepes
groups.comparisonSentence: Unlike deep-fried tofu, these banana leaf-steamed plant proteins offer lean isoflavones and amino acids without absorbing thermal degradation oils.
groups.message: Steamed plant proteins supply high-quality amino acids to address your protein deficit without adding saturated fats or increasing your LDL cholesterol. Banana leaf wrapping imparts flavor without excess oil. Choose the plain tofu pepes, and ask for minimal salt during preparation.

groups.groupName: Tier 4 - Neutral Choice: Stir-Fried Greens & Non-Starchy Veggies
groups.comparisonSentence: While rich in micronutrients and fiber, these wok-tossed dishes introduce cooking oils and sometimes shrimp paste, requiring portion mindfulness compared to water-boiled options.
groups.message: Stir-fried vegetables supply beneficial antioxidants and dietary fiber, but the cooking oils and occasional salted fish or shrimp paste contribute to your saturated fat and sodium surpluses. Select simple garlic stir-fries like kangkung or toge, and ask the chef to use half the usual oil.

groups.groupName: Tier 5 - Neutral Choice: Plain Carbohydrate Staples
groups.comparisonSentence: Unlike fried rices or coconut rices, plain white rice offers a controlled glycemic vehicle without hidden fats, though portion control remains vital for HbA1c control.
groups.message: Plain white rice is free of saturated fats and added sugars, making it easier to manage your caloric surplus compared to specialty rices. However, its refined nature impacts blood glucose. Request a half-portion size to better manage your HbA1c targets.
items: NASI PUTIH / PLAIN RICE

groups.groupName: Tier 6 - Warning Choice: Lean Grilled / Steamed Whole Fish
groups.comparisonSentence: While these whole fish options provide vital marine omega-3s (EPA/DHA) superior to land meats, their package meals include fried components that elevate saturated fats and sodium.
groups.message: Whole fish provides cardioprotective omega-3 fatty acids that benefit your lipid profile, but these menu packages bundle fried tempeh, tofu, and rich rice, exacerbating your calorie and saturated fat surpluses. Order the fish package with grilled preparation and ask to substitute plain rice for the uduk rice.

groups.message: Coconut rice and fried carbohydrate staples introduce substantial saturated fats from coconut milk and thermal oils, directly worsening your high LDL and calorie surpluses while accelerating glycemic spikes. Avoid these dishes entirely or strictly select plain unseasoned grains.

groups.message: Deep-fried poultry, duck, beef empal, and quail packages deliver a heavy load of saturated fats and calories, severely worsening your active LDL and caloric surpluses. Avoid these fried packages entirely; if animal protein is needed, opt for grilled, unglazed alternatives.
